newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Libya's foreign minister visits Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Libya's foreign minister visits Zaire.

text.p: Libyan Foreign Minister Omar Mustafa al-Montasser arrived in Zaire's capital Kinshasa on Monday for talks with the Zairean authorities, foreign ministry sources said.
Diplomats said Montasser, who arrived from Cameroon, was due to leave Zaire on Wednesday.
President Mobutu Sese Seko paid a rare official visit to Libya in 1995 although the two countries do not have a history of warm relations.
Mobutu, who spent four months in Europe after cancer surgery, returned home briefly in December and reshuffled the government and military leadership with a view to hitting back at the rebels.
